layers.name: Presentation & Verifier Cockpit
layers.description: User interface layer built with React, Vite, TailwindCSS, Lucide icons, and XYFlow, providing the Decision Console, Executive Hub, Audit Ledger Inspector, and Mobile JKN simulation.

layers.name: API & Cyber Defense Security
layers.description: FastAPI gateway with D3FEND security architecture, enforcing RBAC access control, rate limiting, token authentication, cryptographic header enforcement, privacy masking, and SQL/prompt injection guards.

layers.name: Multi-Signal Triage & AI Intelligence
layers.description: Core claim decision-support intelligence engine executing deterministic rules, unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly scoring, ChromaDB semantic clinical guideline RAG, and ReAct forensic investigations.

layers.name: Forensic Analytics, Graph & Interoperability
layers.description: In-process analytical query engine, longitudinal episode knowledge graph, OSRM physical geovelocity engine, FHIR R4 interoperability gateway, and Prometheus monitoring.

layers.name: Testing & Automated Quality Assurance
layers.description: Comprehensive backend and frontend automated testing suites ensuring 100% test coverage across security, scoring, fraud detection, and multi-framework verification.

layers.name: Architecture, Documentation & Governance
layers.description: Formal Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), Ubiquitous Domain Glossary, changelogs, agent specifications, and project build configurations.

tour.title: ClaimTrace JKN Overview & Finalist Milestone
tour.description: Start with the project documentation, ubiquitous domain glossary, and formal release notes to grasp the multi-signal triage paradigm, BPJS Kesehatan business processes, and finalist milestone capabilities.

tour.title: Architectural Decision Records & Governance
tour.description: Inspect the architectural foundation including multi-signal triage design, immutable SHA-256 chained audit ledger, zero-PHI privacy scrubber, and high-performance embedded analytical store.

tour.title: FastAPI Gateway & D3FEND Security Controls
tour.description: Explore the secure API gateway featuring strict CORS validation, JWT/session management, rate limiting, and defense against injection and privacy leaks.

tour.title: Quad-Triangulasi Sinyal Triase Independen
tour.description: Dive into the four complementary triage signals: deterministic regulatory rules, unsupervised ML anomaly detection, semantic RAG clinical validation, and ReAct forensic trajectories.

tour.title: Advanced Forensic Engines: Graph, Geovelocity & FHIR
tour.description: Examine the spatial and temporal fraud detection capabilities: OSRM road velocity calculations for physician mobility, longitudinal patient episode graphs, and FHIR R4 interoperability.

tour.title: Verifier Decision Console & Human-in-the-Loop
tour.description: Review the frontend decision cockpit where verifiers inspect multi-signal evidence cards, execute tiered approvals, and seal immutable SHA-256 ledger blocks with digital BAKB generation.

tour.title: Post-Healthkathon Expansion Suite
tour.description: Tour the 4 expansion pillars created for scale: Isolated Database Analytics Console, Physician Geovelocity Map, Healthcare Facility Surveillance, and Interactive Regulatory Inquiries.
